sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report documents unauthorized financial transactions identified on account C10434 associated with payment card C10434-K1. On 2016-12-02, transaction 3506725 was initiated through the online channel under suspicious parameters matching the card not present fraud typology. Total unauthorized exposure across the incident is $1,000.03 USD. Institutional investigation determined the activity was inconsistent with the cardholder's established transactional and regional baseline. In accordance with bank fraud policy, the card was blocked and scheduled for reissue, associated accounts were placed under elevated monitoring, and the transaction was declined to prevent further loss. This filing is submitted pursuant to FinCEN suspicious activity reporting mandates regarding cyber-enabled payment fraud.
